lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into a non-linear maze-like configuration anteriorly, transitioning to a rectilinear grid of horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming localized nodes of maximum luminance across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear feature is present along the upper lateral flank, marked by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light dorsal pixels to darker ventral shadow pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A trailing white linear feature is attached to the ventral posterior region. The trailing margin of the pectoral fin exhibits minor structural irregularities or notches.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark elongated silhouettes indicative of commensal fish are visible near the pectoral and ventral regions. The area immediately posterior to the gill slits displays a high-contrast vermiculated pattern of spots merging into sinuous lines.
